rows.en:
(...Gary-sensei made us run way too much...
How many kilometers did we even run...?)

\p-kun,
good work today.
Wasn't it rough on you too, Shirakawa?
You mean today's marathon?

Yeah. I'd think that was a brutal distance
for a girl.
It wasn't really that bad...
It was good training.

Well, I'm going to go get changed.
See you.
(...Shirakawa is amazing...)

(...Gary-sensei made us run way too much...
I wonder how many kilometers we ran...)

\p-san,
good work today.
Wasn't it rough on you too, Miyuki?

Yeah. I'd think that was a brutal distance
for us girls...
(...Is Miyuki secretly superhuman?)

(...Today was the release day for the new manga.
I almost missed buying it.)

Hey, Shirakawa.
Are you out shopping too?
I ran out of tea leaves, so I came to buy some...
So, did you find what you were looking for?

They're a rare kind, so it took a little
searching, but yes.
rows.notes: Both variants, Miyuki. The trailing "kedo" implies she found them (the player answers "that's good"); "but yes" makes that explicit.

rows.en: Well, glad to hear it.

Oh, I have someone waiting for me,
so I'll be going now.
(Maybe I'll have some tea before heading home.)

(...Today was the release day for my magazine.
I almost missed buying it~)

Oh, Miyuki!
Are you out shopping too?
So, did you find what you were after?
That's great~
(Swimming's next, huh... Perfect pool weather.)
H-hello...
rows.notes: Male. Miyuki in her swimsuit, embarrassed.

rows.en:
What are you getting so embarrassed about...?
You're making me embarrassed too...
P-please don't stare at me like that.

Stare? Come on...
I think that swimsuit looks pretty good on you.
S-stop making... sexual harassment remarks!
That counts as sexual harassment?
(Girls are so hard to figure out...)
(Swimming's next, huh... Perfect pool weather!)
Oh, \p-san...
Miyuki, the weather's great today!

Why are you embarrassed? We're both girls...
You're making me embarrassed too.
Sexual harassment?! How?!
(...But we're both girls...)
(Physics is next, huh...)
H-huh...?
rows.notes: Both variants, player rummaging for the homework.

rows.en:
\p-kun,
is something wrong?
...I forgot my physics homework...

I see. That's too bad.
You'd better hurry and apologize to the teacher.

Don't be like that...
Sorry to ask, but could I see your notes?
...I don't... particularly mind, but...

Yes!
Thanks, Shirakawa!!

...Please move in closer.
You can't see from over there, can you?
O-okay, thanks...
(Shirakawa smells really nice...)

\p-san,
is something wrong?

Don't say that...
Please! Could I see your notes?
...Sigh... I don't mind, but...

Yes!
Thanks, Miyuki!!
(Miyuki has such beautiful skin...)
Hehe...
rows.notes: x4, Miyuki giggling (kusukusu) twice per variant: at the growling stomach, and before sharing her lunch. Her settled laugh "Hehe".

rows.en:
Sh-Shirakawa...
Did you hear that just now?
Yes. I heard a really loud growl.

Ahaha, actually I skipped breakfast...
And I forgot my wallet too. I'm in a real fix.

That's no good. You have to eat properly,
or it'll affect how well you learn.

What about you, Shirakawa?
Did you bring a lunch?
Yes. I got up this morning and made it.

I'll share a little with you,
so shall we eat together?
Aww... thank you...
(Shirakawa's homemade lunch was delicious!)
(Lunch break at last~ I'm starving...)

M-Miyuki...
Did you hear that just now?
Yeah. I heard a really loud growl.

Ahaha, actually I skipped breakfast...
And I forgot my wallet, so no lunch either...

What about you, Miyuki?
Did you bring a lunch?
(Miyuki's homemade lunch was delicious~)

uncertain: c18472: the trailing 'kedo' (it took some searching, but...) rendered with an explicit 'but yes' (she found them), as the player's reply 'that's good' requires.
